title: Bright rain at rest: INT8 vs FP8 model (synthetic test scene)
note: Sixteen consecutive frames of a still camera with bright rain streaks, 4K Balanced. The FP8 model leaves more bright specks (full check: 5,431 pixels brighter than 20 levels vs 1,314 for INT8). FP8 emulated through Proton's FP16 WMMA path on an RX 7800 XT. Display mapping x/(1+x), gamma 1/2.2 (not a game's tone mapping).
